chunks.heading: **Getting Started**
chunks.content:
• Register on **isnp.irda.gov.in** with your license number, Email Address and Mobile Number 

• User Credentials will be sent to mobile and your registered email ID 

• Log-on to **isnp.irda.gov.in** with your user credentials 

• • Complete the registration process on the portal
